name: delegation-policy-a-condition-dropped
why: A lead hands on the delegated allow without its condition: every pull request, whatever its base. Dropping a condition widens a statement, so it is not within (ADR 26-10-20-782 §11).

purposes: allow update on pull request in repository "discobox-ai/discobox" when "its base is main"
uses: allow update on pull request in repository "discobox-ai/discobox"
